topFive: Designed and engineered the cloud migration of legacy LAMP/Symfony applications to AWS, developing RESTful APIs with S3/MinIO storage and strict semantic versioning for seamless backward compatibility.

Refactored a critical scoring mechanism and optimized MySQL databases by eliminating nested loops and indexing tables, reducing latency by 50%, cutting regression bugs by 45%, and resolving severe memory spikes.
Migrated heavy business logic from the front-end to high-performance PHP backend services, successfully cutting peak processing times down to a 30–45 second range.
Engineered logging architectures to meet strict HIPAA standards, implementing robust data auditing across core FormIO modules and increasing form compliance ratings from 70% to over 80%.

Championed Agile engineering best practices by introducing robust design patterns, establishing a Playwright automated testing framework, and mentoring junior developers on clean code and code reviews.

data.title: Charlie's Little Office
top3: I'm creating an open-source, pixel-art RPG using Phaser 4, React, Elf and TypeScript that flips traditional recruiting paradigms by casting the recruiter as the "Hero" on Christopher Vogler’s narrative framework.
My endeavor replaces rapid-scan resume skimming with spatial exploration of a digital-twin home office, this helps to eliminate superficial visual presentation biases.

I'm leveraging Phaser 4’s Render Node architecture and SpriteGPU layers to compile and output professional records directly as WebGL graphical vectors, inherently shielding sensitive candidate data from automated malicious web-scraping scripts

data.title: Playwright Testing Framework
situation: Bugs re-appeared from time to time.
data.task: Integrate Playwright into the Compliance Platform (i.e. a Symfony monolith).
actions: Architectured and implemented a framework-agnostic Playwright + TypeScript E2E testing and test strategy from scratch.
Created a database-agnostic data-hydration pipeline paired with local MinIO storage, AWS S3 for production and GitHub Actions.
Included a sequential test-chaining engine that mirrors end-to-end user journeys using Gherkin.
results: Ensured test coverage of medical compliance features from 0% to 83.3%
My framework became the company-wide E2E framework for Symfony and Ruby on Rails.

services.title: Platform Stabilization & Emergency Remediation
pitchLines: I step into volatile, under-performing legacy codebases to stop active technical fires, optimize core performance, and restore operational stability; allowing your internal team to refocus on building new revenue features.
I love the code your team hates. I specialize in legacy stabilization and deep performance optimization. I fix the foundation so your team can build the future.
Every hour your core team spends hunting legacy bugs is an hour they aren't shipping new features. Outsource the fire to me, keep your team happy, and protect your existing infrastructure investment.
audience: B2B SaaS Companies: High churn risks if the platform lags or crashes.
Logistics & Supply Chain: Systems that run 24/7 where a single bug halts operations.
Private Equity Firms: They often buy older tech companies and need to stabilize the software quickly without hiring a massive, permanent team.
